Flagstaff Day Trip from Phoenix: Your Complete Mountain Escape Guide

When the Phoenix thermometer climbs past 110°F, locals know the secret: head north to Flagstaff. Straight up I-17, this mountain town sits at 7,000 feet where pines replace saguaros and summer highs rarely exceed 85°F. A Flagstaff day trip offers a complete climate and culture change — and with professional transportation, you can enjoy every winding mile.

The short answer: a Flagstaff day trip is a 12-hour booking, and 12 hours earns two free hours, so you pay for 10. On the Executive Sprinter (14 seats, $145/hr) that's $1,450 before tax — about $104 per person with a full van. On the Luxury SUV (6 seats, $125/hr) it's $1,250, about $208 per person. See our Flagstaff snow day tour for the winter version.

Why Flagstaff?

The Temperature Difference

MonthPhoenix HighFlagstaff HighDifference
June104°F79°F-25°F
July106°F82°F-24°F
August104°F80°F-24°F

What You'll Find

  • Historic Downtown: Route 66 heritage, local shops, craft breweries
  • Natural Beauty: Coconino National Forest, mountain trails
  • Cultural Attractions: Museum of Northern Arizona, Lowell Observatory
  • Winter Sports: Arizona Snowbowl (seasonal)
  • Unique Climate: Four seasons, something Phoenix doesn't have

The Journey: Phoenix to Flagstaff

The Route

  • Distance: 145 miles
  • Route: I-17 North (the entire way)
  • Elevation Change: 1,100 feet to 7,000 feet

What You'll See

The I-17 drive is scenic in its own right:

  • Desert floor to Prescott National Forest
  • Red rocks near Camp Verde
  • Pine forests approaching Flagstaff
  • Dramatic elevation change visible in the vegetation

Why Not Drive Yourself?

  • Mountain roads, especially in winter, can be challenging
  • You'll want to look out the window, not at the road
  • Enjoying local breweries requires a designated driver
  • Returning tired after a full day isn't ideal

Every day trip is simply the hourly rate × billed hours. Long days earn free hours: 7-11 hours earns 1, 12-14 hours earns 2, 15+ hours earns 3.

Sample Flagstaff Day Trip Itineraries

The Classic Day Trip

Vehicle: Luxury SUV (4 adults from Scottsdale)

Timeline:

  • 7:00 AM: Pickup from Scottsdale hotel
  • 7:30 AM: Coffee stop in North Phoenix
  • 9:30 AM: Arrive Flagstaff, stretch legs
  • 10:00 AM: Explore downtown Flagstaff (Route 66, shops)
  • 12:00 PM: Lunch at Pizzicletta or Tourist Home
  • 1:30 PM: Museum of Northern Arizona
  • 3:30 PM: Scenic drive through the pines (optional hiking stop)
  • 5:00 PM: Early dinner and brewery visit
  • 6:30 PM: Depart Flagstaff
  • 9:00 PM: Return to Scottsdale

Cost: 14 hours requested, 12 billed (two free): $1,500 before tax — $375 per person for four

Summer Escape (Beat the Heat)

Vehicle: Executive Sprinter (8 friends)

Timeline:

  • 6:00 AM: Pickup from multiple Phoenix locations
  • 8:30 AM: Arrive Flagstaff
  • 9:00 AM: Breakfast at Macy's European Coffeehouse
  • 10:00 AM: Morning hike at Picture Canyon or Buffalo Park
  • 12:30 PM: Lunch downtown
  • 2:00 PM: Lowell Observatory (daytime exhibits)
  • 4:00 PM: Flagstaff Brewing Company
  • 5:30 PM: Walk historic downtown
  • 6:30 PM: Depart Flagstaff
  • 9:00 PM: Return to Phoenix

Cost: 15 hours requested, 12 billed (three free): $1,740 before tax — about $218 per person split eight ways, or about $124 each if you fill all 14 seats

Winter Snow Day

Vehicle: Luxury SUV

Timeline:

  • 7:00 AM: Pickup from Phoenix
  • 9:30 AM: Arrive Arizona Snowbowl
  • 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM: Skiing, snowboarding, or scenic chairlift
  • 3:30 PM: Late lunch in downtown Flagstaff
  • 5:00 PM: Browse shops, warm up
  • 6:00 PM: Depart for Phoenix
  • 8:30 PM: Return home

Cost: 14 hours requested, 12 billed: $1,500 before tax. Book it as our Flagstaff snow day tour.

What to Do in Flagstaff

Downtown Exploration (2-3 hours)

  • Heritage Square: Heart of downtown
  • Route 66: Historic main street
  • Local Shops: Bookstores, outdoor gear, art galleries
  • Historic Buildings: 1920s-era architecture

Craft Breweries (1-2 hours)

Flagstaff has an excellent craft beer scene:

  • Mother Road Brewing Company
  • Flagstaff Brewing Company
  • Lumberyard Brewing Company
  • Dark Sky Brewing Company

Museums & Attractions (1-2 hours each)

  • Museum of Northern Arizona: Native American culture, natural history
  • Lowell Observatory: Where Pluto was discovered
  • Riordan Mansion: Arts and Crafts era mansion

Outdoor Activities

  • Summer: Hiking, mountain biking, scenic drives
  • Winter: Skiing at Snowbowl, snowshoeing, sledding
  • Year-Round: Scenic overlooks, wildlife viewing

Seasonal Considerations

Summer (June-August)

  • Why Go: Escape Phoenix heat
  • What to Expect: Perfect weather (70s-80s)
  • Crowds: Moderate to heavy (other Phoenicians have the same idea)
  • Book: availability varies by date; request a current quote

Fall (September-November)

  • Why Go: Fall colors in late September/October
  • What to Expect: Cool, crisp air (50s-60s)
  • Crowds: Moderate
  • Book: availability varies by date; request a current quote

Winter (December-February)

  • Why Go: Snow, skiing, holiday atmosphere
  • What to Expect: Cold, snowy (20s-40s)
  • Considerations: Road conditions (our drivers are prepared)
  • Book: availability varies by date; request a current quote

Spring (March-May)

  • Why Go: Mild weather, fewer crowds
  • What to Expect: Variable (40s-60s)
  • Bonus: Shoulder season before the summer rush
  • Book: availability varies by date; request a current quote

Flagstaff Day Trip FAQ

Q: Is the drive to Flagstaff scenic?
A: Yes! The I-17 corridor transitions through multiple ecosystems and includes some beautiful stretches.

Q: What if there's snow on the roads?
A: Our drivers are experienced with winter mountain driving. We monitor conditions and adjust as needed.

Q: Can we extend to an overnight trip?
A: Yes. Each day is priced at the hourly rate with the free-hour rule; our Lake Powell overnight tour shows how a two-day trip works.

Q: Is Flagstaff worth it in summer?
A: 100%. The temperature difference is dramatic and refreshing.

Q: How early should we leave Phoenix?
A: A 7 AM departure is ideal for a full day in Flagstaff.

Q: What's the cancellation policy?
A: Cancellation terms depend on your date and booking; read the cancellation policy before you book. One free date change at 72+ hours. See our policies page.
